Drop the per-cell matrices from a fit

Source: R/stash.R
compactFit.Rd

A fit stores the fitted means and the contamination offsets as dense cells by genes matrices. On a real cohort those dominate its size, and nothing downstream needs them kept: paceDecompose() and paceDrivers() read per-cell-type summaries the fit also holds, and rebuild the matrices from the counts when they are absent.

Usage

compactFit(
  object,
  which = c("mu", "mu_bio", "mu_spill", "technical_offset_mat", "bleed_offset_mat")
)

Arguments

object

A PACEFit.

which

The matrices to drop. The default is all of them.

Value

object, without the named matrices.

Details

Use this before saving a fit. Every readout still works afterwards, and re-decomposing a compacted fit reproduces the tables it already carries.

See also

stashPACE() for keeping the readouts with the data.

Examples

fit <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "pace_fit_example.rds", package = "PACE"))
small <- compactFit(fit)
c(before = object.size(fit), after = object.size(small)) |> format(units = "MB")
#>    before     after 
#> "7086784" "7086784"
